title: leucophyllum frutescens
intro: Leucophyllum frutescens, commonly known as Texas Sage or Cenizo, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Leucophyllum frutescens include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce stress and anxiety, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Leucophyllum frutescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
